# Multishow Brazilian Music Award for Pop of the Year

}}Multishow Brazilian Music Award for Pop of the Year is an annual award presented at the Multishow Brazilian Music Award, a ceremony established in 1994 and originally called the TVZ Award. The Pop of the Year category was created in 2023 as part of a reformulation of the Multishow Award Academy's guidelines. Previously, the Song of the Year award encompassed various musical genres within a single category. However, starting in 2023, this category was divided, giving rise to 11 new categories, each dedicated to a specific musical genre, including Brazilian pop.
This change aimed to recognize the diversity of genres present in Brazilian music and to provide greater space for popular styles that hold a significant presence in the country's music scene. The Pop of the Year category highlights the most impactful songs within the genre, honoring artists who contribute to the evolution and popularity of pop music in Brazil.
